notices.title: Design, Supply, Installation, Testing and Commissioning of 500kV GIS Substation expansion at Mardan including associated 500kV bay extensions

notices.title: Procurement of OPGW, hardware and stringing of 220kV D/C transmission line section Jhelum-Mardan
notices.description: Supply of OPGW, conductor hardware and stringing equipment services for 220kV double circuit transmission line section between Jhelum and Mardan. Single stage one envelope.
